usable_lessons: BG_A/B plus line scroll is plausible for a chase scene when measured.
Visual and technical gates must remain separate.
Sprite transparency and matte gates are mandatory for hero assets.
Multi-frame BlastEm evidence is stronger than static screenshots for motion claims.
Benchmark evidence does not transfer to a new project.
revive_decision: Use benchmark as budget/risk reference only; create authorial docs, assets and evidence inside the Revive project.
